tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Open the visitor's mail client with a pre-filled draft to Hansraj Singh Thakur. Nothing is sent until the visitor presses send.

tools.name: get_contact_links
tools.description: Get contact channels: GitHub, LinkedIn, and email.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Get career history as a list of eras with years, role, location, and highlights (2011 to present).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get Hansraj Singh Thakur's profile: name, headline, bio, location, availability for work, and primary links.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full details for one project by name (e.g. 'AgentMesh', 'PMChat', 'OllamaBar', 'Mission Control', 'InterviewAgent').

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Get skills grouped by category (AI/ML, frontend, backend, mobile/desktop, hardware).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List portfolio projects with description, status, tech stack, and GitHub URL. Optionally filter by status or a keyword.

status.description: Only return projects with this status.

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword matched against name, description, and stack (e.g. 'agents', 'Swift').

tools.name: navigate_to_section
tools.description: Scroll the page to a named section. Sections: dossier (Dossier), about (About), chronology (Chronology), artefacts (Artefacts), matrix (Capability Matrix), signal (Now-shipping), contact (Contact).
